privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.metaDescription: How Sova collects, uses and protects personal data.

s1.title: 1. Who the data controller is
s1.text: The data controller is {company}, the owner of the {product} platform available at {domain}. For any questions about data protection, write to {email}.

items.account: Account data: name, email address, password (stored only as a hash by our authentication processor), language, time zone, notification settings.
items.brand: Brand data: your website URL and the publicly available content on it (text, logo, colours, fonts, images, information about your services), descriptions you enter yourself, information about competitors you add.
items.social: Data from connected social networks: the ID and name of the account or page, profile picture, access tokens the network issues to us when you approve the connection, your past posts with public metrics (reach, reactions, comments), metrics for posts Sova publishes on your behalf.
items.content: Content you create in Sova: post text, photos and videos you upload, generated images, strategies, comments and approval decisions.
items.payment: Payment data: processed by Stripe. We store only the customer ID, plan, subscription status and token history. Your card number never reaches us.
items.technical: Technical data: IP address, browser and device type, access times, error logs, cookies needed for your session.
items.team: Team member and client data: the email addresses of people you invite to your workspace and their decisions on approving posts.

items.service: Providing the service you asked for (website analysis, content creation, scheduling and publishing, analytics): performance of a contract.
items.security: Account security, preventing abuse and fixing errors: legitimate interest.
items.billing: Billing and accounting records: performance of a contract and legal obligation.
items.emails: Emails about your account status, failed posts and approvals: performance of a contract. Marketing emails only with your consent, which you can withdraw at any time.
items.analytics: Product usage analytics and non-essential cookies: consent.

s4.title: 4. Data from third-party platforms
s4.p1: When you connect Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, X, YouTube, Pinterest or Google Business Profile, Sova gets access only to the data you approved during the connection. We use that data only for the features you asked for: publishing content on your behalf, importing past posts to learn about your brand, and showing metrics. We do not sell platform data, use it for advertising or share it with third parties other than the processors listed in section 5. Access tokens are stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM) and deleted as soon as you disconnect the account.
s4.p2: Sova's use of information received from Google APIs (YouTube, Google Business Profile, Google sign-in) adheres to the <policy>Google API Services User Data Policy</policy>, including the Limited Use requirements. Our use of data from Meta platforms complies with the Meta Platform Terms, and our use of data from TikTok complies with the TikTok Developer Terms.

s5.title: 5. Processors we entrust with data

processors.gemini: Google (Gemini API): generating text and images, analysing website content and images
processors.stripe: Stripe: billing for subscriptions and token packs
processors.media: Unsplash and Canva: photos and designs, only when you choose them

s5.text: We have a data processing agreement with each processor. Some of them process data in the United States; these transfers rely on Standard Contractual Clauses or the EU-US Data Privacy Framework.

s6.title: 6. Artificial intelligence
s6.text: We use the Google Gemini API to generate text and images and to analyse websites. We send Gemini the public content of your website, your brand description, your inputs and any photos you attach yourself. Under the terms of the paid Gemini API, Google does not use this data to train its models. Visuals made by artificial intelligence are labelled as AI-generated in the app, and where a network supports it, Sova also adds a label to the post itself.

items.account: Account and brand data: while the account exists, and then for no more than 30 days after the account is deleted.
items.tokens: Network access tokens: while the account is connected; they are deleted as soon as you disconnect.
items.invoices: Payment data and invoices: for the period required by accounting regulations.

s8.title: 8. Your rights
s8.p1: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the Law on Personal Data Protection of the Republic of Serbia, you have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability, objection to processing and withdrawal of consent. Send your request to <mail>{email}</mail> and we will reply within 30 days. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Commissioner for Information of Public Importance and Personal Data Protection (Serbia) or with the supervisory authority in your country.
s8.p2: You can delete your account and all your data yourself, without contacting us. The process is described on the <deletion>Data deletion</deletion> page.

s9.title: 9. Cookies
s9.text: Essential cookies are used for logging in, protecting against abuse and remembering your language, and do not require consent. Usage analytics cookies are set only if you accept them. You can set your browser to refuse cookies, but logging in will not work without the essential ones.

s10.title: 10. Security
s10.text: Data travels encrypted (TLS). Access tokens are encrypted in the database, access to data is restricted by database-level policies so that each user sees only their own workspace, and staff access is logged. No system is completely secure; in the event of a data breach, we will notify you and the competent authority within the legal deadline.

s11.title: 11. Children
s11.text: Sova is intended for business users over the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect children's data.

s12.title: 12. Changes
s12.text: We will tell you about important changes to this policy by email or with a notice in the app at least 14 days before they take effect.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.metaDescription: The terms under which you use the Sova platform.

s1.title: 1. Parties and acceptance
s1.text: You enter into these terms with {company} (“we”), the owner of the {product} platform. By registering an account, you confirm that you have read and accepted them. If you open an account on behalf of a company or agency, you confirm that you are authorised to bind it.

s2.title: 2. What Sova is
s2.text: Sova is software that helps you run social media: it analyses your website, suggests a strategy, generates text and visuals with the help of artificial intelligence, schedules and publishes content on the networks you connect, and shows the results. Sova is a tool; you decide what gets published.

items.age: You must be at least 18 years old and provide accurate information.
items.password: You are responsible for keeping your password safe and for everything that happens under your account. We recommend two-factor authentication.
items.free: One free account per person. Opening several free accounts to get extra tokens is not allowed.
items.team: Team members and clients you invite to your workspace are bound by the same terms.

s4.title: 4. Connected social networks
s4.text: By connecting an account on a network, you authorise Sova to publish on your behalf content you have approved or content created in Autopilot mode that you switched on yourself, to import your past posts and to read metrics. You can withdraw this authorisation at any time in the app (Networks → Disconnect) or in the network's own settings. You must follow the rules of each network; we are not responsible for restrictions, rejections or suspensions a network applies to your account.

items.yours: Content you upload or create in Sova remains yours. You only give us permission to process, store and publish it on your behalf as far as the service needs in order to work.
items.accuracy: Content generated by artificial intelligence may be inaccurate or inappropriate. Review it before publishing. Sova checks facts only against the information in your brand profile and does not guarantee accuracy.
items.responsibility: You are responsible for everything you publish: copyright in photos, the accuracy of prices and claims, compliance with advertising regulations and network rules.
items.forbidden: The following are prohibited: unlawful, offensive, misleading or discriminatory content; spam; content that infringes other people's rights; attempts to get around security measures or the limits of AI services.
items.thirdParty: Photos from Unsplash and designs from Canva are subject to those services' terms, which you accept when you use them.

items.usage: Actions that use artificial intelligence consume tokens. The price of each action is shown in the app before you confirm. Tokens are reserved before an action and charged only when it succeeds; a failed action uses no tokens.
items.allowance: A free account gets a one-off amount of tokens after the email address is confirmed. Monthly and yearly plans get tokens for each billing period; unused subscription tokens do not carry over to the next period. Token packs bought separately do not expire.
items.renewal: Subscriptions are charged in advance through Stripe and renew automatically until you cancel them. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current period; you keep access until then.
items.prices: Prices may change with at least 30 days' notice; the change applies from the next billing period.
items.refunds: Used tokens cannot be refunded. For an unused subscription, you can ask for a refund within the first 14 days of your first purchase by writing to our support address.
items.value: Tokens have no monetary value outside Sova and cannot be transferred between workspaces.

s7.title: 7. Availability and support
s7.text: We do our best to keep Sova running without interruption, but we do not guarantee availability. Sova depends on social network APIs, the Google Gemini service and other suppliers we have no control over; their outages, rule changes or withdrawal of access may disable certain features temporarily or permanently. If a post fails, Sova lets you know and offers a retry or manual publishing.

s8.title: 8. Intellectual property
s8.text: The software, design, the Sova name and the documentation belong to us or to our licensors. You may not copy, modify, decompile or resell Sova without written permission. We may freely use any feedback you give us.

s9.title: 9. Limitation of liability
s9.text: Sova is provided “as is”. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect damage, lost profits, loss of data or the consequences of content you have published. Our total liability under these terms is limited to the amount you paid us in the 12 months before the event that caused the damage. Nothing in these terms excludes liability that cannot be excluded by law.

s10.title: 10. Termination
s10.text: You can delete your account at any time (the process is on the <deletion>Data deletion</deletion> page). We may suspend or close an account that breaches these terms, network rules or the law, with notice where reasonably possible. The provisions on content, liability and governing law continue to apply after termination.

s11.title: 11. Governing law
s11.text: These terms are governed by the law of the country where {company} is registered, subject to the mandatory consumer and personal data protection rules of your country of residence. We will first try to resolve any dispute by agreement.

s12.title: 12. Changes to these terms
s12.text: We will tell you about changes to these terms by email or in the app at least 14 days in advance. Continuing to use Sova after that period means you accept the changes.

dataDeletion.title: Data deletion
dataDeletion.metaDescription: How to delete your account, disconnect a network or ask for your data to be deleted from Sova.

received.title: Your deletion request has been received.
received.text: Confirmation code: <mono>{code}</mono>. Deletion is completed within 30 days. We will let you know at the email address linked to your account once it is done.

s1.title: 1. Deleting your whole account (in the app)

items.open: Open Settings → Privacy and data → Delete account.
items.confirm: Type your email address to confirm and click “Delete account”.
items.result: Sova immediately revokes the access tokens for all connected networks, cancels scheduled posts and deletes your data. Deletion from backups is completed within 30 days at the latest.

s1.note: If you are the only owner of a workspace that has other members, first transfer ownership or delete the workspace; the app walks you through this step.

s2.title: 2. Disconnecting a single network
s2.p1: Open Networks, find the account and click “Disconnect”. Sova deletes the access token, imported posts and metrics for that account. Content already published stays on the network; you delete it directly on the network.
s2.p2: You can also disconnect from the network's side: Facebook and Instagram (Settings → Apps and websites), LinkedIn (Settings → App permissions), TikTok (Settings → Security → Apps), X (Settings → Connected apps), Google (myaccount.google.com → Security → Third-party apps), Pinterest (Settings → Security → Connected apps). Sova detects this and deletes the tokens.

s3.title: 3. Request by email
s3.subject: Data deletion
s3.text: If you can't log in, send an email from the address you registered with to <mail>{email}</mail> with the subject “Data deletion”. We will confirm your identity and delete your data within 30 days.

s4.title: 4. What is deleted and what stays

items.deleted: Deleted: your profile, workspaces you are the only owner of, brands, the brand profile and brand knowledge, connected accounts and tokens, imported and created posts, media, strategies, metrics, notifications.
items.kept: Kept for the legal period: invoices and payment data we must keep under accounting regulations, as well as anonymised aggregate usage data that cannot identify you.
items.member: If you are a member of someone else's workspace, your personal data is deleted, while the content you created for that workspace stays with its owner.

s5.title: 5. Automatic requests from Facebook and Instagram
s5.text: When you remove Sova in your Facebook or Instagram account settings, Meta automatically sends us a deletion request. Sova immediately deletes that account's data and gives you a confirmation code and a link to this page, where you can check the status.

botPage.metaDescription: What SovaBot is, when it reads websites and how to allow or block it.

what.title: What SovaBot is
what.text: SovaBot is the website reader of the Sova app ({company}). It runs when a brand owner enters their website address in Sova, so that Sova can learn the brand's offer, tone and visual identity. SovaBot does not crawl the internet on its own and does not read websites nobody has entered.

items.robots: Respects robots.txt (User-agent token: SovaBot) and Crawl-delay.
items.pages: Reads no more than 60 pages per analysis, 3 at a time, and pauses when the site asks it to.
items.sitemap: After the first analysis, checks the sitemap and RSS once a week; does not fetch pages again unless the owner asks.
items.forms: Does not fill in forms, log in or run JavaScript.

block.title: How to block it
block.text: Sova will then show the brand owner a message saying the site does not allow reading, and offer to enter the information manually. For questions, write to {email}.
